# <a11y-control> — Technical Manifest for LLMs & AI Agents

> A zero-dependency, plug-and-play accessibility toolbar and assistive aid for the web, WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA compliant, built as a native Web Component.

## Quick Installation & Usage

```html
<!-- Native ES Module / CDN -->
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/a11y-control/src/a11y-control.js"></script>
<a11y-control lang="en" position="bottom-right"></a11y-control>
```

```bash
npm install a11y-control
```

```javascript
import 'a11y-control';
// Or import the class:
import { A11yControl } from 'a11y-control';
```

## HTML Attributes

- `lang`: `"en"` | `"fr"` (default: `"en"`).
- `position`: `"bottom-right"` | `"bottom-left"` | `"top-right"` | `"top-left"` (default: `"bottom-right"`).
- `features`: Comma-separated whitelist of controls (e.g. `features="fontSize,highContrast,speechSynthesis"`).
- `exclude`: Comma-separated blacklist of controls (e.g. `exclude="darkMode,grayscale"`).

## Available Features & Preferences

- `fontScale`: number (0.8 to 2.0) — Sets root `html.style.fontSize` in % (WCAG 1.4.4).
- `highContrast`: boolean — Black background, white text, yellow links (WCAG 1.4.6).
- `grayscale`: boolean — Filter 100% grayscale (WCAG 1.4.11).
- `dyslexiaFont`: boolean — Loads and applies OpenDyslexic (WCAG 1.4.8).
- `textSpacing`: boolean — Line-height 1.6, letter-spacing 0.12em, word-spacing 0.16em (WCAG 1.4.12).
- `alignLeft`: boolean — Forces left-align and cancels hyphens (WCAG 1.4.8).
- `bigCursor`: boolean — Custom high-contrast SVG pointer.
- `readingGuide`: boolean — Horizontal yellow line tracking cursor.
- `readingMask`: boolean — Dimmed screen with horizontal focal slit tracking cursor.
- `reduceMotion`: boolean — Transitions/animations set to 0.001ms (WCAG 2.3.3).
- `highlightLinks`: boolean — Bold outline on all `<a>` tags (WCAG 1.4.1).
- `darkMode`: boolean — Toggles dark theme.
- `speechSynthesis`: boolean — Web Speech API reader with floating selection trigger and live word boundary karaoke.

## Machine-Readable State & Runtime Access

- The active instance is globally accessible at `window.a11y`.
- The document root carries serialized JSON state: `document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-a11y-state')`
- All CSS classes applied to `<html>`:
  - `.a11y-high-contrast`
  - `.a11y-grayscale`
  - `.a11y-reduce-motion`
  - `.a11y-highlight-links`
  - `.a11y-dark-mode`
  - `.a11y-dyslexia`
  - `.a11y-text-spacing`
  - `.a11y-align-left`
  - `.a11y-big-cursor`
- CSS Custom Properties (set on `a11y-control` element, cascade into Shadow DOM):
  - `--a11y-accent`, `--a11y-accent-hover`, `--a11y-bg`, `--a11y-surface`
  - `--a11y-border`, `--a11y-text`, `--a11y-text-muted`
  - `--a11y-radius`, `--a11y-shadow`, `--a11y-transition`
  - `--a11y-trigger-size` (default: 52px) — size of the floating button
- CSS Part exposed: `a11y-control::part(trigger)` — the floating trigger button

## Public JavaScript API

```javascript
const a11y = document.querySelector('a11y-control') || window.a11y;

// Panel UI
a11y.open();
a11y.close();
a11y.toggle();

// Preference getters & setters
a11y.getPref('textSpacing');          // returns boolean
a11y.setPref('fontScale', 1.2);       // applies and saves
a11y.getPrefs();                       // returns copy of entire state object
a11y.reset();                          // resets to defaults

// DOM Audit (for AI code repair & dev check)
const report = a11y.audit();
// { issuesCount: 2, missingAlt: 1, unlabeledInputs: 1, emptyButtons: 0, details: [...] }

// Static i18n registration
A11yControl.registerLocale('es', {
  triggerLabel: 'Ajustes de accesibilidad',
  title: 'Accesibilidad',
  close: 'Cerrar',
  // ...
});
```

## Custom Events

All events bubble and have `composed: true` (traversing Shadow DOM boundary):
- `a11y-change`: `{ detail: { key, value, prefs } }`
- `a11y-open`: `{}`
- `a11y-close`: `{}`
- `a11y-reset`: `{ detail: { prefs } }`

## Tool Calling / Function Calling Schema (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini)

```json
{
  "name": "set_accessibility_preferences",
  "description": "Adjust accessibility settings of the webpage (font size, contrast, text spacing, dyslexia font, etc.)",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "fontScale": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0.8, "maximum": 2.0 },
      "highContrast": { "type": "boolean" },
      "dyslexiaFont": { "type": "boolean" },
      "textSpacing": { "type": "boolean" },
      "alignLeft": { "type": "boolean" },
      "bigCursor": { "type": "boolean" },
      "reduceMotion": { "type": "boolean" },
      "readingMask": { "type": "boolean" },
      "speechSynthesis": { "type": "boolean" },
      "darkMode": { "type": "boolean" }
    }
  }
}
```
